result.rationale: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim via raw SQL ('INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ("#{h}", ...)') with no normalization, while EmbeddableHost.record_for_host matches via 'where("lower(host) = ?", host)' with host = URI(host).host. Legacy values like 'http://eviltrout.com' — which the old SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? handled via URI(h).host normalization and which the deleted specs explicitly tested — would be stored with the scheme and never match. The before_validation stripping in embeddable_host.rb is bypassed by raw SQL. Real migration defec

judged_text: The migration inserts legacy `embeddable_hosts` setting values verbatim via raw SQL, bypassing EmbeddableHost's before_validation scheme/path stripping, so legacy entries like 'http://eviltrout.com' or 'https://example.com/1234' — which the removed SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? matched via URI(h).host and the deleted site_setting_spec cases explicitly exercised — are stored un-normalized. record_for_host compares lower(host) = URI(host).host exactly, so those migrated rows never match and embedding from those hosts silently starts returning InvalidAccess after upgrade (imports fall to Uncategorized); the new specs mask this because they build hosts through the model, which normalizes them.
